title: The suspended step of the stork opinion

commenti.body:
I'm glad you enjoyed it. Have you watched any more film by Theo Angelopoulos? He is my favorite director.

"The Suspended Step of the Stork" is quite a cryptic film and I didn't "get" it at first. However, the more I watched and thought about it, the more I loved it. Some of the long takes are jaw-dropping and have been burned into my brain. I think the film is among top 3 cinematography of Theo's filmography.

No, i haven't seen any more of his films (tho im gonna once i get my hands on one).
Which one do you recomend i watch next?
'Landscape in the Mist" and "Eternity and a Day" are his most accessible and universally loved films. Those two along with "The Weeping Meadow" are my top 3 favorite of him.
Cool, ill check them out when i can

It’s a part of Theo’s Border Trilogy, if you like it I’d recommend also watching Ulysses’ Gaze and Eternity and a day. 

Voyage to Cythera is another great. He is likely one of the greatest filmmakers to ever work, but his stuff is very involved with Balkan politics and the geopolitical zeitgeist of the time. It’s definitely valuable to watch his stuff alongside some scholarly texts—Andrew Horton has a great book on his films if you’re interested.
